summary: Patrol 'caret' of a character walking a spline (patrolling guards, wandering NPCs): which spline, the current control point, positions and state. Run by esv::patrol::CaretSystem (Toolkit names: Activate, Enable, Disable, TryPlace, UpdateInactive, ProcessClearRequests, ClearBSPatrolState) and read by esv::ActivationManager. macOS has a method on the component itself, esv::patrol::CaretComponent::GotoNextSplinePoint(ls::SplineTemplate const&). The struct is 4-byte aligned (size 0x54), so it holds no pointers. Seen.py context: helm/idle levels and many dialogues (CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration, DEN refugees) - NPCs with patrol splines.

fields.name: SplineId
fields.evidence: Registration bg3.exe+0x26FF170 sets destructor bg3.exe+0x698FE0 = FixedString release at +0; macOS default ctor writes -1 (null) in the low dword of +0. Live: 46 distinct FixedString indices. Probably the spline (template) id; the name is a guess. Converter bg3.exe+0x277FF60 (model ls::model::game::patrol::v1::CaretComponent, 72 bytes -> runtime 0x54) fills it with a FixedString created from the model's leading Guid (formatted %08x-%04hx-...): the spline's id. The save loader bg3.exe+0x2591640 copies the runtime struct into the 0x54-byte component member by member with this width.
